prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a maple avenue in full autumn colour with a pale path scattered with red and gold leaves, a standard park bench and lamp posts, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as the figure, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, the camera set back far enough that the whole figure is visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on the figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

ONE real adult Hawaiian person with the face of a beautiful woman, the face exactly the same tone as the body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted sapphire drop, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a silver small flared temple bell, a bronze square-sided cowbell, an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a lead ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten platinum necklaces. Extremely long almond nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
Physique: the body of an extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. The head stays in correct proportion to the broad frame; the arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
Body Art: The bare skin is painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic (a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls), wide carved cream bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense leaf scrolls filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers the whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of the hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of the feet. The face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
Pose: both hands on the hips, elbows out.
Footwear: Extreme silver platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than the ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
